head_commit.message:
docs: indent continuation line in Session.get :param params:

PR #7429 added a :param params: field on Session.get but the
continuation line was left at the same indent as the field itself,
so docutils treats the field list as ending mid-block:

    WARNING: Field list ends without a blank line; unexpected unindent.

Downstream projects using :inherited-members: on Session subclasses
hit this on every build; projects with -W / fail_on_warning fail
outright. Indenting the continuation four spaces matches the
convention used by Session.request and requests.api.get.
